feat(security): VaultCredentialStore — Vault KV v2 adapter with InMemory fallback, 28 tests

- vault_credential_store.py: VaultCredentialStore implements same interface as
  InMemoryCredentialStore; VaultConfig (from_env(): VAULT_TOKEN/VAULT_ADDR/
  VAULT_SECRET_ENGINE); _probe_vault() checks /v1/sys/health at startup;
  fallback to InMemoryCredentialStore when Vault unreachable or token missing;
  Vault KV v2 mapping: save→PUT, get→GET, revoke→mark revoked, purge→fallback
- ZSP-01 enforcement preserved: all scope restrictions via JITCredentialManager
  (Level-3 blocked from EMIT_DECISION/APPEND_AUDIT/CHECK_EMERGENCY/ORCHESTRATE)
- get_credential_manager(prefer_vault=True): factory — selects Vault or InMemory
  based on VAULT_TOKEN env + reachability; singleton; backward compatible
- WARNING log when falling back to InMemory (StructuredLogger)
- 28 tests: all run in fallback mode (no real Vault needed)

Sprint 5 migration path from G-10: swap InMemoryCredentialStore → VaultCredentialStore
via JITCredentialManager(store=VaultCredentialStore(config=...))
